summary: Iter161: tested the VM / virtualization-host port feature. Unit tests: test_vm_port_iter161 passed 5/5, regression test_mac_follow_iter154 passed 13/13, test_alert_rules_iter160 passed 4/4. New API pytest test_vm_host_api_iter161.py passed 3/3. It seeds switch 10.161.0.1 (client TEST_VM161): port 52 has a physical host TEST_HYPERV01 plus 2 Hyper-V VMs (SRVDC, SRVDATI); port 10 has a single PC. Results: vm_host={kind:Hyper-V, host_name TEST_HYPERV01, host_ip, host_mac, vms[2]} on port 52; null on port 10; no cross-tenant leak. UI check with Playwright after admin login + TOTP: the table badge port-vmhost-badge-52 shows 'Host Hyper-V · 2 VM' and no attached toggle; there is no badge on port 10. Clicking tile 52 shows port-vmhost-52 with 'PORTA HOST DI VIRTUALIZZAZIONE · HYPER-V · 2 VM', the host line 'Connesso a TEST_HYPERV01 10.161.0.10 AA:BB:CC:00:16:01', and both port-vmhost-vm-52-<mac> rows. The legacy neighbor block and the AttachedList are hidden. Port 10 still shows the legacy 'Connesso a'. All seed data was cleaned up (count 0 in every collection).

minor.issue: Group matching uses m['ip'] (KeyError if a NIC group member has no ip). Use m.get('ip').

issues: On a vm_host port, the header 'Dispositivi visti sulla porta · N' (switch-port-attached-detail-<idx>) still shows with an empty body because only AttachedList is hidden. Hide the whole block when vm_host is set, or move the count into the VmHostBlock. The same empty header also appears for single-device ports (port 10 shows '· 1' with nothing below).

action_items: Hide the orphaned 'Dispositivi visti sulla porta' header on vm_host ports (cosmetic)
Use m.get('ip') in build_vm_host group matching
critical_code_review_comments: routes/topology.py is ~2450 lines; split it up (get_switch_ports alone is ~500 lines).
'from vm_port import build_vm_host' sits inside the per-port loop; move it out of the loop.

_refresh_devices migration path: if there is no port_devices yet and len(cur)>1, all current MACs are treated as known. A real swap that happens during the first refresh after deploy will therefore be silent. This is probably acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Seeded and then removed: client_id TEST_VM161, switch 10.161.0.1 (switch_ports, managed_devices, discovered_endpoints). Set KEEP_SEED=1 to keep the seed for UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: set -a; . backend/.env; . frontend/.env; set +a; pytest tests/test_vm_host_api_iter161.py. The test logs in with admin + TOTP and retries after 31 seconds if the code is rejected. UI route: /switch-ports/<ip>?clientId=<cid>.
